sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Tarun Kushwah - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Vinod Thakur - G.A. appearing on behalf of Advoc  ORDER 1.

2. This is the applicant's second application under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023 (Section 439 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973), as he / she is implicated in connection with Crime No.255/2021 registered at Police Station Sarwan, District Ratlam (MP) for offence punishable under Section Section 302, 201, 376 of IPC.
The applicant is lodged in jail since 28/10/2021.

3. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
4.

Having considered the rival submissions and on perusal of the case diary, looking to the brutality of the offence where the prosecutrix was rapped and murdered by the applicant, and the DNA report is also positive, no case for grant of bail is made out.

However, considering the fact NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:17471 2 MCRC-27710-2025 that the applicant is lodged in jail since 28/10/2021,
the learned Judge of the trial Court is requested to conclude the trial as expeditiously as possible,
Narayan Maida vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161148686/
1 preferably within a period of six months.
